decisions.question: Say on the calendar card that TaskFlow's reminders can come more and more often as a task's day gets closer? It is reminder plans' free half: no AI, and it works offline. It would replace the ‘it asks you once’ clause that WP59 cuts, so the sentence becomes EN `TaskFlow can remind you of tasks with a date, more and more often as the day gets closer.` / ES `TaskFlow puede recordarte las tareas con fecha, cada vez más a menudo según se acerca el día.` / CA `TaskFlow et pot recordar les tasques amb data, cada cop més sovint a mesura que s’acosta el dia.` (review F's copy; the Catalan needs a native read).
decisions.recommendation: Yes, on the card only, in these words. For: it is free, needs no AI and is true today; it is your own reason for the feature (a project three weeks away); it sharpens the card's existing reminder sentence instead of adding one (27 → 36 words in English, after WP59's cut); and it says it the app's way (‘More and more often’ / «Cada vez más a menudo» / «Cada cop més sovint» in the reminder sheet) without quoting a label or listing options. Against: the app's /ux review of reminder plans is still running (the row's name, how many notices a far task gets, what the offer's «Sí» sets), though the sentence depends on none of these; repeating tasks get no plan in this first version (`ReminderPlans.plannable`), which ‘can’ keeps true; the live demo can't show reminders. Not in the hero (the core loop comes first), not in the FAQ's free list, and not in the voice answer: a rhythm said to the live demo may come out as a note or a second task (owner check 1). If you say yes, one small package changes the same three lines after WP59.

decisions.question: Add ‘reminders in your own words’ (Pro: a rhythm you type or say, read by Google's AI) to the Pro list in the FAQ's ‘Is TaskFlow free?’ answer?
decisions.recommendation: Not now. Revisit when Pro's price is set, or when the app's Pro screen names it. For: it is Pro's newest feature, and someone comparing apps might value it. Against: the site's Pro line mirrors the app's Pro screen, which still sums Pro up as ‘Unlimited dictations, and room for all your files.’ (`billingIntro`, unchanged by reminder plans); the free answer is already 80 words in English, with a 38-word Pro sentence; the feature's name is under the app's review; and the live demo can't show it. Nothing on the site is false without it: once WP58 lands, privacy §4 covers the words it sends.
